DECLARE @DATEF CHAR(10)=#{sdate}, @DATET CHAR(10)=#{edate}, @CVCOD NUMERIC(12,0)=#{J_ID1}; WITH TEMP1 AS ( -- 이월 SELECT Z1.ACCOD , Z1.CVCOD , SUM(Z1.JAMT) AS JAMT FROM ( SELECT ISNULL(A1.ACDRJN, 0) + ISNULL(A1.ACCRJN, 0) JAMT , A1.ACCOD , A1.CVCOD FROM ACJANF A1 WHERE A1.ACYEAR = SUBSTRING(@DATEF,1,4) UNION ALL SELECT ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN B1.ACRDR = '1' THEN ISNULL(ACAMT, 0) - ISNULL(ADAMT, 0) ELSE ISNULL(ADAMT, 0) - ISNULL(ACAMT, 0) END), 0) AS JAMT , A1.ACCOD , A1.CVCOD FROM ACTRAN A1 LEFT JOIN ACMSTF B1 ON A1.ACCOD = B1.ACCOD WHERE A1.TDATE BETWEEN SUBSTRING(@DATEF, 1, 4) + '0101' AND CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(DAY, -1, CONVERT(DATE, @DATEF)), 112) AND A1.APVYN = 'Y' GROUP BY A1.ACCOD, A1.CVCOD )Z1 GROUP BY Z1.ACCOD, Z1.CVCOD ), TEMP2 AS ( --전표데이터 SELECT A1.TDATE , A1.ATGUB , A1.SEQNO , A1.LINNO , A1.CVCOD , A1.ACCOD , A1.ATEXT , A1.ACAMT , A1.ADAMT FROM ACTRAN A1 WHERE A1.TDATE BETWEEN @DATEF AND @DATET AND A1.APVYN = 'Y' ), TEMP3 AS ( --거래처별, 계정별 잔액/ 계정코드/계정과목명/이월금액/차변금액/대변금액/잔액 SELECT Z1.CVCOD --계정코드 , Z1.ACCOD --계정과목코드 , Z2.ACDSP --계정과목명 , ISNULL(SUM(JAMT),0) AS IWOL --이월금액 , ISNULL(SUM(ACAMT),0) AS ACAMT --차변금액 , ISNULL(SUM(ADAMT),0) AS ADAMT --대변금액 , (CASE WHEN Z2.ACRDR = '1' THEN ISNULL(SUM(JAMT),0)+ISNULL(SUM(ACAMT),0)-ISNULL(SUM(ADAMT),0) ELSE ISNULL(SUM(JAMT),0)-ISNULL(SUM(ACAMT),0)+ISNULL(SUM(ADAMT),0) END) AS JAN --잔액 FROM ( SELECT CVCOD , ACCOD , JAMT , 0 AS ACAMT , 0 AS ADAMT FROM TEMP1 UNION ALL SELECT CVCOD , ACCOD , 0 , SUM(ACAMT) AS ACAMT , SUM(ADAMT) AS ADAMT FROM TEMP2 GROUP BY CVCOD, ACCOD )Z1 LEFT JOIN ACMSTF Z2 ON Z1.ACCOD = Z2.ACCOD GROUP BY Z1.CVCOD, Z1.ACCOD, Z2.ACRDR, Z2.ACDSP )
SELECT A1.CVCOD , REPLACE(A1.ACCOD, ' ','') AS ACCOD , A1.ACDSP AS ACNAM , A1.IWOL AS CARRY_OVER_AMT , A1.ACAMT , A1.ADAMT , A1.JAN AS BAL_AMT FROM TEMP3 A1 WHERE A1.CVCOD = @CVCOD AND (A1.IWOL != 0 OR A1.ACAMT != 0 OR A1.ADAMT != 0) AND ACCOD = 0251

SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY Y1.J_DATE, Y1.IDX, Y1.SEQNO, Y1.LINNO) AS NUM , Y1.J_DATE , Y1.J_ID1 , Y1.J_CARRYID , Y1.J_BNUM , Y1.J_ID , Y1.GUBUN1 , Y1.IWEIGHT , Y1.DANGA , Y1.IKONGKEP , Y1.CKONGKEP , Y1.DAEGUBUN , Y1.K_JUKYO , Y1.K_CHA , Y1.K_DAE , Y1.J_BUGASE , Y1.KERATYPE , Y1.SEQNO , Y1.HALIN FROM ( SELECT '1' AS IDX , A.JUNPYOID , A.J_DATE AS J_DATE , A.TAXNO , A.J_ID1 , A.J_CARRYID , CAST(B.J_BNUM AS CHAR) AS J_BNUM , A.J_ID , C.GUBUN1 AS GUBUN1 , A.IWEIGHT AS IWEIGHT , A.DANGA AS DANGA , A.IKONGKEP AS IKONGKEP , A.CKONGKEP AS CKONGKEP , C.DAEGUBUN AS DAEGUBUN , D.ATEXT AS K_JUKYO , ISNULL(D.ACAMT,0) AS K_CHA , ISNULL(A.IKONGKEP ,0) AS K_DAE , ISNULL(A.BUGASE ,0) AS J_BUGASE , A.KERATYPE , D.SEQNO , D.LINNO , A.HALIN AS HALIN FROM INLIST A LEFT OUTER JOIN MESURING B ON A.J_ID = B.IPCHULGO_MAIPID LEFT OUTER JOIN JAJAE C ON A.J_SERIAL = C.J_SERIAL LEFT OUTER JOIN ACTRAN D ON A.J_ID = D.REF2 WHERE D.ACCOD = '0251' AND A.KERATYPE = '매입' AND A.J_DATE BETWEEN #{sdate} AND #{edate} AND A.J_ID1 = #{J_ID1} UNION ALL SELECT '0' AS IDX , 0 AS JUNPYOID , CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),CONVERT(DATE,A.TDATE),23) AS J_DATE , '' , NULL , NULL , '' AS J_BNUM , '' , '' AS GUBUN1 , 0 AS IWEIGHT , 0 AS DANGA , A.ADAMT AS IKONGKEP , 0 AS CKONGKEP , '' AS DAEGUBUN , '' AS K_JUKYO , IIF(A.ACAMT=0, -A.ADAMT, A.ACAMT) AS K_CHA , 0 AS K_DAE , 0 AS J_BUGASE , '' AS KERATYPE , '' AS SEQNO , NULL AS LINNO , 0 AS HALIN FROM ACTRAN A WHERE A.TDATE BETWEEN CONVERT(VARCHAR(8),CONVERT(DATE,#{sdate}),112) AND CONVERT(VARCHAR(8),CONVERT(DATE,#{edate}),112) AND A.CVCOD = #{J_ID1} AND A.ACCOD = '0251' AND A.ACAMT IS NOT NULL AND A.APVYN = 'Y' ) Y1

SELECT SUBSTRING(A.J_DATE,1,4) AS YY , SUBSTRING(A.J_DATE,6,2)AS MM , SUBSTRING(A.J_DATE,9,2)AS DD , C.GUBUN1 AS GUBUN1 , CAST(B.J_BNUM AS CHAR) AS J_BNUM , A.IWEIGHT AS IWEIGHT , A.HALIN AS HALIN , A.DANGA AS DANGA , A.IKONGKEP AS IKONGKEP , ISNULL(A.BUGASE ,0) AS J_BUGASE , A.IKONGKEP+ISNULL(A.BUGASE ,0) AS TOTAMT , E.IDT_NO , E.DEALER_NM , E.REP_NM , CASE WHEN E.ADDR != '' AND E.ADDR IS NOT NULL THEN E.ADDR + ' ' + E.DTL_ADDR ELSE E.DTL_ADDR END AS ADDR , E.BIZ_NM , E.TYPE_NM FROM INLIST A LEFT OUTER JOIN MESURING B ON A.J_ID = B.IPCHULGO_MAIPID LEFT OUTER JOIN JAJAE C ON A.J_SERIAL = C.J_SERIAL LEFT OUTER JOIN ACTRAN D ON A.J_ID = D.REF2 LEFT JOIN ACC_DEALER_CD E ON A.J_ID1 = E.DEALER_CD WHERE D.ACCOD = '0251' AND A.KERATYPE = '매입' AND A.J_DATE BETWEEN #{sdate} AND #{edate} AND A.J_ID1 = #{J_ID1} ORDER BY A.J_DATE, A.GUBUN1, B.J_BNUM
